newsitem.title: USA: Giant pet snake strangles New York teen.
newsitem.headline: Giant pet snake strangles New York teen.

text.p: A Bronx teenager was found dead at home with his 45-pound (20 kilogram) pet python wrapped around him Wednesday afternoon, police said.
A neighbour called police after seeing the 19-year-old young man bleeding and lying unconscious halfway outside the doorway to his apartment, police said.
Police said full investigation would be needed to determine if the snake had indeed killed the man. The 10-foot (three metre) snake was taken to the Bronx Zoo.
